name: Pola Orbis Holdings Inc.
summary: Pola Orbis Holdings Inc., through its subsidiaries, develops, manufactures, and sells cosmetics and related products in Japan, Asia, and internationally. It operates through Beauty Care, Real Estate, and Others segments. The company offers beauty and health products under the POLA, ORBIS, Jurlique, THREE, DECENCIA, and FUJIMI brand names. It is also involved in the leasing of office buildings in urban areas, as well as management and operation of buildings. Pola Orbis Holdings Inc. was founded in 1929 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
